capabilities: Export individual notes as self-contained HTML files
Export a linked note network as one HTML file with SPA navigation, sidebar, and search
Resolve wiki links and embed renderings of other plugins such as Excalidraw diagrams
Wrap exports in self-extracting gzip-compressed HTML containers
Report export size statistics by category and largest artifacts
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via the BRAT plugin is recommended.
intentEvidence: While Obsidian has built-in HTML export capabilities, this plugin offers several advantages
problem: Obsidian's built-in HTML export loses wiki links, nested note formatting, and rendered output of other plugins, and produces files with external dependencies.

relations.evidence: Ensure you have the Obsidian Excalidraw Plugin installed and enabled.
Captures and exports the rendered output from other Obsidian plugins (like Dataview, Kanban, etc.)
Captures and exports the rendered output from other Obsidian plugins (like Dataview, Kanban, etc.)

summary: Exports individual notes or whole linked wikis as single self-contained HTML files with sidebar navigation, compression, and size statistics.
